variants.bio: X-Terion takes on the form of a low-poly Sonic, but with moderate differences. He lacks an actual head, it being replaced by a white glowing signature (which is a W shape, with each curve a loop and two dots on both ends) that, while essentially a one-sided texture, will always turn to face the viewer. His body is a bit brighter blue, and his skin is no longer skin colored, but yellow. He sports a large purple business tie, signifying that he used to work at SEGA. His gloves and shoe cuffs are a bit of a marble color. His shoes are extremely darker than the normal Speed Shoe, and the straps are the same color as his tie, purple.
